name: The Lumberjack
description: When the fall chill starts creeping in, bundle up in this flannel shirt. People looking at you will be able to tell that you are a lumberjack. And that you are okay.

options.name: Peacock Addon
options.description: Install the suit to your game as an addon without replacing existing suits. This will only work if you're playing with Peacock.

UI_TOKEN_OUTFIT_HERO_THE_LUMBERJACK_DESC.english: When the fall chill starts creeping in, bundle up in this flannel shirt. People looking at you will be able to tell that you are a lumberjack. And that you are okay.
UI_TOKEN_OUTFIT_HERO_THE_LUMBERJACK_DESC.french: Lorsque la fraîcheur de l'automne commencera à se faire sentir, emmitouflez-vous dans cette chemise en flanelle. Les gens qui vous regarderont pourront dire que vous êtes un bûcheron. Et que vous allez bien.
UI_TOKEN_OUTFIT_HERO_THE_LUMBERJACK_DESC.italian: Quando il freddo autunnale inizia ad insinuarsi, copritevi con questa camicia di flanella. Chi vi guarderà potrà dire che siete un boscaiolo. E che state bene.
UI_TOKEN_OUTFIT_HERO_THE_LUMBERJACK_DESC.german: Wenn die Herbstkälte hereinbricht, wickeln Sie sich in dieses Flanellhemd ein. Die Leute, die dich ansehen, werden erkennen, dass du ein Holzfäller bist. Und dass es dir gut geht.
UI_TOKEN_OUTFIT_HERO_THE_LUMBERJACK_DESC.spanish: Cuando empiece a refrescar, abrígate con esta camisa de franela. La gente que te mire sabrá que eres un leñador. Y que estás bien.
UI_TOKEN_OUTFIT_HERO_THE_LUMBERJACK_DESC.russian: Когда наступит осенняя прохлада, закутайтесь в эту фланелевую рубашку. Люди, глядя на вас, смогут сказать, что вы - дровосек. И что с вами все в порядке.
